identity: Starbough's boughs are being emptied by snares: poachers trap what the vale raises and sell it to the bandits at the old camp.

quests.title: [PH] Sunleaf for the Snared
quests.text: [PH] Ilyra sees the poaching first on the forest: bring 5 Sunleaf for the animals hurt by the snares. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The zone's first errand, a level only; the early potion choice.
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] A Knot With Another Purpose
quests.text: [PH] Ilyra sends the player to the {name:snare_ground} in the {name:lower_boughs} to make a snare bundle harmless; a knot that could hold up a young tree became a trap. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] The danger at that spot is gone. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people (draft K15).
quests.notes: Round 59 BANDQUESTS: free play, a level only.

quests.title: [PH] Stand Against {name:snarekeeper_vetch}
quests.text: [PH] Nima demands the fight against Poacher Snarekeeper Vetch {dir_from_giver:snarekeeper_vetch} in the {name:high_boughs}, who turns tending knowledge into traps. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] Nima has named Vetch, and Vetch is down. Real text to follow.
